observations: Photo 0 shows the top-right side of a DSLR camera with a lens attached, held in hand over a plaid fabric. The body has buttons labeled 'MIC', 'HDMI', 'GPS', and a hot shoe. The lens has a switch marked 'M/A' and 'M'.

Photo 1 shows the front of the camera with the lens cap on. The brand 'Nikon' is visible on the top plate, and the model 'D7100' is visible on the front right side. The lens cap has a hinge and is partially open.

Photo 2 shows the back of the camera with a black screen, control dials, and buttons labeled 'MENU', 'WB', 'QUAL', 'ISO', 'AE-L/AF-L', and 'Info'. The 'Nikon' logo is visible at the bottom of the screen.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI OREOLUWA'.
The camera appears to be black with a textured grip. No batteries or 50mm lens are visible in any photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows 'Nikon' and 'D7100' on the front plate.
No lens is visible in any photo; the lens attached in photo 0 is not labeled, and no 50mm lens is shown separately.
No batteries are visible in any photo.

risks.risk: Camera may not be functional (e.g., screen, shutter, or sensor issues)
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the camera powering on, screen displaying, and shutter operating.

risks.risk: Lens attached is not a 50mm, or 50mm lens is missing
risks.proof: Photo of the lens with focal length marked, or a photo of the 50mm lens separately.
Photo of the two batteries, preferably with model number visible, and a photo showing them powering the camera.

risks.risk: Camera body has hidden damage (e.g., sensor smudges, dents, or internal wear)
risks.proof: Photo of the sensor (with lens removed and mirror up) and close-up of the body for scratches or dents.

proof_requests: Photo of the 50mm lens with focal length visible, or confirmation that it is included.
Photo of the two batteries, preferably with model number visible.
Video or photo showing the camera powering on, screen working, and shutter operating.
Photo of the sensor (with lens removed and mirror up) and close-up of the body for damage.
response.reason: The camera model is confirmed as Nikon D7100, but the seller's claims about the 50mm lens and two batteries are unverified. The functional state and condition of the camera are also unknown. Without proof of the accessories and functionality, a worst-case price cannot be determined.
